executionPhases.name: preflight
checks: Verify writer gate allows enablement but keeps writerEnabled false.
Verify load-policy indexes are visible through API readiness.
Verify skipped records are acknowledged by the operator approval artifact.
Verify SQL preview remains dry-run only before opening a database transaction.

executionPhases.name: transaction
checks: Open exactly one database transaction for the full load plan.
Execute statements in preview order only.
Rollback on first write, validation, or constraint failure.
Commit only after all row counts and affected-row counts match the SQL preview summary.

executionPhases.name: postCommit
checks: Record committed row counts by table.
Record skipped record counts by reason.
Record source ids and row indexes for every executed statement.
Record the final API readiness payload after commit.

forbiddenActions: Do not write unsupported cached sources.
Do not execute SQL that is absent from the reviewed SQL preview.
Do not continue after a failed statement.
Do not enable this writer while mutationStatus is disabled.
